name: repo-enforcement
description: Install, plan, apply, and verify enforceable repository-level GRC merge gates.

interface.shortDescription: Make GRC checks enforceable at merge time.
interface.longDescription: Inspect a repository, generate a reviewable offline GRC policy and workflow, ratchet existing debt, and safely plan, apply, and verify GitHub rulesets without coupling merge approval to a Noru write.
capabilities: Local read: repository policy, manifests, workflows and CODEOWNERS
Local write: confirmation-gated setup files and cache-only plans
GitHub read: repository identity, teams, checks and effective rulesets
GitHub write: confirmation-gated dedicated repository ruleset
interface.defaultPrompt: Inspect this repository and propose the smallest safe GRC enforcement rollout. Do not modify GitHub and do not write to Noru.
